name: nginx-proxy-manager
description_en: Docker container for managing Nginx proxy hosts with a simple, powerful interface
readme_excerpt: This project comes as a pre-built Docker image that enables you to easily forward to your websites running at home or otherwise, including free SSL, without having to know too much about Nginx or Letsencrypt. - Quick Setup - Full Setup - Screenshots Project Goal I created this project to fill a personal need to provide users with an easy way to accomplish reverse proxying hosts with SSL termination, and it had to be so easy that a monkey could do it.
